description: Hello, we are the organ hackers and our challenge is Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions. And we love and we love gaming, learning, crafting, and participating .
summary: For our NASA challenge, we developed AstroMed, an autonomous health monitoring system designed specifically for deep-space missions. On long journeys, astronauts face serious challenges like microgravity bone loss, space radiation, and communication delays of up to 22 minutes from Earth, meaning they need fast, independent healthcare. To solve this, we built a vertical Tinkercad 3D medical capsule model equipped with internal scanning rings and roof sensors for physical health checks. This hardware pairs directly with our offline BioPod OS app, which tracks real-time vitals, triggers instant emergency mission alerts during hazards like solar storms, and provides step-by-step action plans. AstroMed empowers astronauts to monitor and act on their health safely when Earth is too far away
details: AstroMed is a physical and digital health monitoring system built for astronauts on deep-space missions using Tinkercad for our 3D model and Lovable for our app. Because astronauts lose 1 to 2 percent of their bone mass per month in microgravity and face up to 22-minute communication delays from Earth, we designed an upright BioPod scanner with internal scanning rings and roof sensors that connects directly to our offline BioPod OS software. Without needing Wi-Fi or Mission Control, the app tracks real-time vitals, triggers bold red emergency alerts during hazards like solar storms, and gives astronauts clear, step-by-step action plans so they can safely treat themselves millions of miles from home.
